stem: During World War I, tanks were used on the western front primarily to —

options.label: F
options.text: lead infantry advances across no-man’s-land and into enemy territory

options.label: G
options.text: destroy railroads and bridges used by enemy troops

options.label: H
options.text: release chemical weapons in advance attacks on enemy positions

options.label: J
options.text: launch long-range rockets at enemy aircraft
